Curving horns extend from the sides of this sheep’s head, giving it a potent butting attack.

Ram
CR 1

XP 400
N Medium animal
Init +1; Senses low-light vision; Perception +9

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 11, flat-footed 12 (+1 Dex, +2 natural)
hp 19 (3d8+3 plus 3)
Fort +4, Ref +4, Will +1
Defensive Abilities ferocity

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee gore +3 (1d6+1)

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 13, Con 12, Int 1, Wis 11, Cha 4
Base Atk +2; CMB +3; CMD 14 (18 vs. trip)
Feats Skill Focus (Perception), Toughness
Skills Perception +9

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate hills, mountains and plains
Organization flock (5–50 sheep plus 1 ram per 10 adults and 2–20 lambs)
Treasure none

Rams are male sheep and are usually encountered leading a flock. Rams attack using their horns. They become aggressive if the flock is threatened.
